title: Champions League Trivia Quiz
description: Think you know your Champions League history? From the first European Cup in 1956 to the modern-day UCL giants, this quiz tests your knowledge of the greatest club football competition on the planet. Cover iconic finals, legendary managers, record scorers, and unforgettable moments across 15 challenging questions. Only true football fans will score at the top.

questions.text: Which club has won the most UEFA Champions League / European Cup titles?
Which club completed the famous 'Miracle of Istanbul' comeback in the 2005 Champions League final?
In what year did the UEFA Champions League rebrand from the European Cup?
Who is the all-time top scorer in UEFA Champions League history?
Which club won the very first European Cup in 1956?
Which team won the 2019 Champions League final, beating Tottenham Hotspur 2-0?
Which city hosted the 2023 UEFA Champions League final?
Which club won the 2012 Champions League final against Bayern Munich on penalties?
Which club won the 2020 UEFA Champions League, defeating PSG in the final?
Which manager led Barcelona to Champions League glory in both 2009 and 2011?
Which club won back-to-back UEFA Champions League titles in 2017 and 2018?
Who was the top scorer in the 2021-22 Champions League season with 15 goals?
Which club won the 2021 Champions League final, beating Manchester City 1-0?
In which year did Manchester United win their most recent UEFA Champions League title?
Which club did Zinedine Zidane manage to win three consecutive Champions League titles from 2016 to 2018?

tiers.label: UCL Legend
tiers.description: You are the ultimate Champions League authority. Your knowledge of UEFA's premier club competition rivals that of the greatest managers and analysts in European football. From the historic European Cup beginnings in 1956 to the modern-day UCL spectacles, you command the facts, the finals, the scorers, and the managers. You'd fit right in on the commentary panel for the biggest nights at the Bernabéu, Anfield, or the Allianz Arena. Champions League football runs through your veins.

tiers.description: You're just getting started with the Champions League, but everyone begins somewhere! The UCL is the most prestigious club competition in the world, featuring the best teams from across Europe battling for glory. From Real Madrid's record haul of titles to unforgettable finals in Istanbul, Lisbon, and beyond, there's a rich history waiting to be discovered. Dive into some classic matches, explore the storied clubs, and come back to challenge this quiz again. Your UCL journey starts now.
